title: WHO IS CHATGPT? BENCHMARKING LLMS' PSYCHOLOGICAL PORTRAYAL USING PSYCHOBENCH
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLMs using psychological scales that directly relate to moral and ethical considerations. Specifically, it uses the Dark Triad (Narcissism, Machiavellianism, Psychopathy) and the Lying Scale from the EPQ-R, identifying these as 'socially undesirable measurements' and 'unethical yet commonplace behaviors.' The analysis section explicitly discusses LLMs exhibiting 'more negative traits than human norms' and consistently scoring high on 'Lying,' linking these to 'unethical yet commonplace behaviors' and 'hypocritical disposition.' The role-play experiments also involve 'psychopath' and 'liar' roles, demonstrating an evaluation of morally relevant behaviors.
